title: Total of floor quotients
description: Divide every element of xs by d, round each quotient down toward negative infinity, and return the sum of the rounded quotients (not the rounded sum). d is positive. An empty list gives 0. For example [-1, -1, -1] with d = 2 gives -3, because each -0.5 rounds down to -1.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states floor semantics (round toward negative infinity) in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
